## Implementation Plan

### 1. #1894 [command] Preserve prompt cache across goal iterations (MEDIUM ~4-6h, HIGH PRIORITY)

**Context**: Kilocode PR #14680 merged 2026-09-30 keeps goal tool schemas stable across goal turns to preserve provider prompt cache. Current Alexi `src/command/goal.ts` regenerates tool schemas on each `agenticChat()` call inside the goal loop, invalidating cache and wasting tokens/cost/latency.

**Approach**:
- Cache tool schemas at goal start (before loop entry) by calling tool registry once and freezing the schema list
- Pass frozen schemas to all `agenticChat()` calls inside goal loop (L190-195) via new options parameter
- Update `src/core/agenticChat.ts` to accept optional pre-cached tool schemas and skip schema regeneration when provided
- Verify prompt cache hit rate improves across goal turns in integration test

**Files to modify**:
- `src/command/goal.ts` (L159-250 goal loop, cache schemas before loop, pass to agenticChat)
- `src/core/agenticChat.ts` (L400-424 tool schema generation, accept optional cached schemas)
- `tests/command/goal.test.ts` (add test case for goal loop with 5+ turns checking cache metrics)

**Tests**:
- Unit test: goal command caches tool schemas at start
- Integration test: 5-turn goal loop verifies `cache_read_input_tokens` increases after turn 1
- Regression test: goal loop without cached schemas still works (backward compat)

**Done when**:
- [ ] Tool schemas cached once at goal start before loop
- [ ] All `agenticChat()` calls in goal loop receive cached schemas
- [ ] Prompt cache hit rate measurably improves (cache_read_input_tokens > 0 after turn 1)
- [ ] Tests pass: `npm run test`
- [ ] Quality gates pass: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test`

### 2. #1893 [provider] Add content-filter finish reason detection and handling (SMALL ~3-4h, HIGH PRIORITY)

**Context**: Cline merged content-filter finish reason detection 2026-09-29. Current Alexi does not check `finishReason === 'content_filter'` in provider responses, so filtered completions are silently retried or treated as generic errors instead of surfacing a user-facing message.

**Approach**:
- Add `finishReason === 'content_filter'` check in provider response handling
- Skip retries when content filter is triggered (permanent failure, not transient)
- Surface user-friendly message explaining content policy violation
- Add telemetry event for content-filter occurrences
- Test with mock provider responses

**Files to modify**:
- `src/providers/sap-ai-core.ts` (or base provider if shared logic exists)
- `src/core/orchestrator.ts` or `src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts` (error handling)
- `src/core/error-backoff.ts` (mark content_filter as permanent, not transient)
- `tests/providers/sap-ai-core.test.ts` (mock content_filter response)

**Tests**:
- Unit test: content_filter finish reason skips retries
- Unit test: user message surfaces for content_filter
- Unit test: telemetry event emitted for content_filter

**Done when**:
- [ ] `finishReason === 'content_filter'` detected in provider responses
- [ ] Retries skipped for content_filter (marked as permanent failure)
- [ ] User-friendly message surfaced to CLI/TUI
- [ ] Telemetry event recorded
- [ ] Tests pass with mock content_filter responses
- [ ] Quality gates pass: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test`

### 3. #1895 [cli] Display wake time for scheduled sessions (SMALL ~2-3h, MEDIUM PRIORITY)

**Context**: Kilocode merged scheduled session status display 2026-09-29. Current Alexi session list in CLI/TUI does not show wake time for scheduled sessions (sessions with pending wakeups or cron tasks), making it unclear when a paused session will resume.

**Approach**:
- Extend session metadata to include next wake time (if scheduled)
- Update CLI `sessions` command to display wake time column
- Update TUI `SessionList.tsx` to show wake time indicator
- Format relative time (e.g., "in 2h 15m") or absolute (e.g., "2026-09-30 14:30 UTC")
- Query scheduled wakeups/crons from session state

**Files to modify**:
- `src/core/sessionManager.ts` (add `nextWakeTime` to session metadata)
- `src/cli/commands/sessions.ts` (display wake time in table output)
- `src/cli/tui/dialogs/SessionList.tsx` (show wake time in session list)
- `tests/core/sessionManager.test.ts` (verify wake time metadata)

**Tests**:
- Unit test: session with scheduled wakeup includes nextWakeTime
- Unit test: sessions command displays wake time column
- Integration test: TUI shows wake time for scheduled sessions

**Done when**:
- [ ] Session metadata includes next wake time for scheduled sessions
- [ ] CLI `sessions` command displays wake time
- [ ] TUI `SessionList.tsx` shows wake time indicator
- [ ] Relative time formatting (e.g., "in 2h 15m")
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Quality gates pass: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test`

### 4. #1892 [provider] Gate prompt cache breakpoints on first-party OpenAI endpoints (SMALL ~2-3h, MEDIUM PRIORITY)

**Context**: Kilocode merged prompt cache breakpoint gating 2026-09-29. Current Alexi may attempt to use prompt cache breakpoints with custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints that do not support the feature, causing errors or unexpected behavior.

**Approach**:
- Add endpoint detection to distinguish first-party OpenAI (api.openai.com) from custom endpoints
- Enable prompt cache breakpoints only for first-party OpenAI endpoints
- Add configuration option to force-enable for known-compatible custom endpoints
- Update provider initialization to check endpoint URL

**Files to modify**:
- `src/providers/openai.ts` (if exists, or relevant provider file)
- `src/core/router.ts` (provider selection logic)
- `src/config/index.ts` (add config option for cache-compatible endpoints)
- `tests/providers/openai.test.ts` (verify cache gating by endpoint)

**Tests**:
- Unit test: first-party OpenAI endpoint enables cache breakpoints
- Unit test: custom endpoint disables cache breakpoints by default
- Unit test: force-enable config overrides default behavior

**Done when**:
- [ ] Endpoint URL detection implemented
- [ ] Cache breakpoints gated on first-party OpenAI endpoints
- [ ] Config option for force-enabling on compatible custom endpoints
- [ ] Tests verify gating behavior
- [ ] Quality gates pass: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test`

### 5. #1896 [cli] Audit TUI glyphs for Linux font compatibility (SMALL ~2-3h, LOW PRIORITY)

**Context**: Cline merged Linux TUI glyph compatibility fix 2026-09-30 (swap U+23F5 to U+25B6 for auto-approve indicator). Current Alexi TUI uses various Unicode glyphs that may not be present in common Linux monospace fonts (DejaVu Sans Mono, JetBrains Mono), rendering as tofu (empty boxes).

**Approach**:
- Audit all TUI files (`src/cli/tui/`, `src/cli/interactive.tsx`) for Unicode glyphs outside ASCII range
- Check glyph coverage in DejaVu Sans Mono and JetBrains Mono via Unicode font charts
- Replace missing glyphs with widely supported alternatives (Box Drawing U+2500-U+257F, Geometric Shapes U+25A0-U+25FF)
- Add platform-specific fallbacks: `process.platform === 'linux' ? FALLBACK_GLYPH : PREFERRED_GLYPH`
- Test on Linux VM with common terminal fonts

**Files to modify**:
- `src/cli/tui/**/*.tsx` (audit and replace glyphs)
- `src/cli/interactive.tsx` (audit and replace glyphs)
- `src/cli/tui/components/Spinner.tsx` (if custom spinner glyphs)
- `src/utils/glyphs.ts` (optional: centralize glyph definitions with platform fallbacks)

**Tests**:
- Manual test: render TUI on Linux with DejaVu Sans Mono
- Manual test: render TUI on Linux with JetBrains Mono
- Unit test: verify platform-specific glyph selection

**Done when**:
- [ ] All TUI glyphs audited for Linux font coverage
- [ ] Missing glyphs replaced with widely supported alternatives
- [ ] Platform-specific fallbacks implemented for Linux
- [ ] Manual testing on Linux VM confirms no tofu rendering
- [ ] Quality gates pass: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test`
